source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-18

procedures.title: Stoplight switch replacement
steps: (Continued) Check the switch: it must close when the brake pedal is pushed 3/8" to 5/8" from fully released.

specs.value: 3/8" to 5/8" pedal travel from fully released (.38-.64" per figure)

procedures.title: Headlamp dimmer switch replacement
steps: Fold back the upper left corner of the front floor mat, release the connector lock fingers and unplug the dimmer switch.
Remove the 2 screws holding the switch to the toe pan.
Plug the connector onto the new switch and check it works.
Fasten the new switch to the toe pan with the 2 screws and lay the mat back.

procedures.title: Backup lamp switch replacement (transmission mounted)
steps: Raise the car on a hoist.
Separate the switch lead from the harness at the in-line connector.
Remove the bolt holding the wiring clip to the transmission.
Remove the wire clip securing the reverse lever rod to the switch.
Remove the screws holding the switch and shield to the transmission and take off the switch.
Install in reverse order and confirm the switch works in reverse.
notes: Do not remove the transmission-to-bracket bolts.
Figure 33 in the manual shows an automatic transmission installation; the manual does not name models for this procedure.
